name: Monoscope

evidence.errors: C02: API and application error tracking with issue grouping (E01, E03)
evidence.uptime: U01, U04: URL uptime monitors and API tests; issue opens after two failures
evidence.logs: L02: logs searched with KQL and live tail; 30-day cloud retention
evidence.performance: A01: APM latency and throughput with trace waterfalls
evidence.cron: J01, J02: cron check-ins with interval and grace; missed check-in opens an issue

line: Tracks API errors, logs and traces, with uptime and cron monitors.
